translation: In the condition of injury with distension and pain of the hypochondrium and flanks, if the stool is free and harmonious, with wheezing, coughing, and spitting of phlegm, this is liver fire insulting the lung (肺); use Minor Bupleurum Decoction (小柴胡湯) with added green tangerine peel (青皮) and gardenia (山梔) to clear it. If there is distension and pain of the chest and abdomen, with the stool not passing, and wheezing, coughing, and spitting of blood, this is stagnation of stagnant blood; use Dang Gui Stagnation-Guiding Powder (當歸導滯散) to free it. The Inner Classic (內經) says: The liver stores blood, the spleen governs blood. This is because the liver belongs to wood, and wood, when it prevails, insults earth; its spleen qi must therefore be deficient. One should first clear the liver and nourish the blood, so that the stagnant blood does not congeal and stagnate; next strengthen the spleen and stomach, so that qi and blood become full and abundant.
